Maya: Morning team  Kickoff for client Asterix tomorrow. Core goals: first end-to-end demo, align success metrics, capture renewal risk signals, and hand off enablement. Quick confirmations? :wave:

Omar: I can cover infra & keys. Need staging VPC access and whether they want Dedicated. If Dedicated requested, timeline +10d. Tagging RISK-DEDICATED.

Tess: I'll run enablement (dev + ops tracks). Will prepare a 20-min demo + 30-min hands-on lab and a one-pager.

Ravi: I'll own adoption KPIs and the renewal watchlist. Proposing early health: 25k tokens/day by day 7 and 5 DAUs hitting the flows.

Maya: Suggested sprint (compact):
Day 0: kickoff + SSO check
Day 1-2: API integration + smoke tests
Day 3-5: perf tuning + batching
Day 6-7: enablement + feedback
Day 8: retro + exec readout
Can people add blockers by EOD? :spiral_calendar:

Omar: SSO risk: if cert exchange > 4d we lose telemetry. Marking RISK-SSO. Also need test key by EOD tomorrow.

Tess: Draft deck: https://go.redwood/asterix-enable (will drop recordings). I'll also publish the post-session feedback form.

Ravi: Success criteria idea: integration green, 3 demo flows pass, median latency <300ms on 512-token sample, and post-training NPS >=7.

Maya: Owners: Tess=enablement, Omar=infra, Ravi=metrics, Maya=exec & escalation.

onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.checklists/1828234567  includes owners, meeting links, enablement deck, and RISK tags.

Omar: +1. Will try to get staging access today. If blocked I'll flag immediately.

Tess: Will send invites for two training tracks and a short pre-read by tonight.

Maya: Great. Daily 10-min stand at 09:00 PST during sprint. If anyone sees a critical risk tag it here and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
